searchText: The ProbeLab team is now monitoring discv5 DHT keyspace density to proactively identify potential Sybil and Eclipse attacks on the network. The relevant plots are published at: https://probelab.io/ethereum/keydensity/. Feedback very welcome! cc: <@194432762315407360> Looks good!
